properties.description:
Please complete the following information to get yourself a *FREE* [Eparé Cutting Board Set](https://epare.com/products/epka05)  
P.S. If you have a scratch card, note that we have updated our gift raffle to no longer require scratch codes, now everybody wins!

fields.title: *To get started please tell us where you made your purchase.*
Please confirm your email address
*And did our product meet your expectations?*
Sorry to hear about that, we are here to help! Contact us by email at info@epare.com or text at +1(347) 682-5121 so that we can resolve your issue.
